valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E. Company FY2027 (Sep-2027) adjusted EPS guide about $7.25 on about 5% sales growth; at the Nov-2027 target date the market looks at FY2028 EPS, modelled at about +9% on the guide. Share count, net debt and FY2026 totals were not sourced in detail; the model uses EPS only. Native USD listing, no ADR conversion.

bear.driver: Project orders fade, margins flat, multiple de-rates

base.driver: Long-cycle orders (+14% underlying in Q4) convert, mid-single-digit sales growth, margin gains

bull.driver: LNG and data-centre automation demand, buybacks, higher margin

valuation.implied_by_close: At FY2027 guide EPS $7.25 the close implies 22.9x; the named-analyst average target (about $182) implies about 23x on $7.90 or EPS near $8.3 at 22x
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $7.90 (about 4.7 pp)
valuation.watch_metric: Underlying orders growth and segment EBITDA margin versus the FY2027 EPS guide of about $7.25
valuation.next_disclosure: Fiscal Q1 2027 earnings, expected early February 2027

analyst_notes: Four named analysts were verified with dated calls after the Nov 4 earnings; all raised targets (+$5 to +$10) and ratings are two Buy, two Hold. Their targets ($160-$196) bracket the base case; the Hold-rated names sit near the close. A Morgan Stanley Nov 17 note is after the reference close and excluded. Sample is small and horizons are undocumented, so targets stay out of the weighted figure.
